verdict.rationale: Rainforest's docs claim that platforms keep full ownership of all payment and merchant data and can export it at any time, which is a direct claim of data portability. However, no export mechanism, format, or offboarding process is documented. The claim also appears on an unrelated JavaScript-bundle page, which weakens confidence. missing for 10: documented export mechanism (bulk export/download endpoint or portal feature), explicit open formats (CSV/JSON), completeness of export scope, offboarding/migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Platforms using Rainforest retain full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time.
